example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়িতে নানা দেবতার নিত্য পূজা-অর্চনা লেগেই আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Daily worship and adoration of various deities is ongoing in the house.
He performs worship and adoration at the temple every day.
note: This is a tautological compound word (একার্থক যুগ্মশব্দ) commonly used in Bengali Hindu contexts for ritualistic devotion.
